points.place: 英国格洛斯特郡伯克利
points.title: 童年启蒙
points.description: 爱德华·詹纳1749年5月17日出生于英国格洛斯特郡伯克利的一个牧师家庭。他的父亲是当地牧师，母亲在詹纳5岁时去世。詹纳从小在伯克利长大，对自然表现出浓厚兴趣。当地医生Daniel Lacester注意到詹纳的天赋，开始教导他医学基础知识。这段乡村生活经历使詹纳对当地民间医学，特别是关于牛痘和天花的关系产生了早期认识，为他后来的重大发现奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Edward Jenner was born on May 17, 1749, in Berkeley, Gloucestershire, England, to a clergyman family. His father was the local vicar, and his mother died when he was five years old. Jenner grew up in Berkeley and showed a keen interest in nature. Local doctor Daniel Lacester noticed Jenner's talents and began teaching him basic medical knowledge. This rural upbringing exposed Jenner to folk medicine, particularly the relationship between cowpox and smallpox, which laid the foundation for his later groundbreaking discovery.

points.title: 医学深造
points.description: 1770年，詹纳前往伦敦，在著名的圣乔治医院师从著名外科医生约翰·亨特。亨特是当时英国最杰出的医学科学家之一，对解剖学、生理学和外科手术都有深入研究。在亨特的指导下，詹纳接受了系统的医学训练，掌握了当时最先进的医学知识和技能。这段经历不仅提升了詹纳的专业水平，更重要的是培养了他严谨的科学思维和实验方法。詹纳与亨特建立了终身友谊，两人经常通信交流医学见解，亨特对詹纳后来的研究工作产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1770, Jenner traveled to London and studied under the renowned surgeon John Hunter at St George's Hospital. Hunter was one of Britain's most distinguished medical scientists of the time, with deep expertise in anatomy, physiology, and surgery. Under Hunter's guidance, Jenner received systematic medical training and mastered the most advanced medical knowledge and techniques of the era. This experience not only enhanced Jenner's professional abilities but, more importantly, cultivated his rigorous scientific thinking and experimental methods. Jenner established a lifelong friendship with Hunter, and they frequently corresponded to exchange medical insights, with Hunter having a profound influence on Jenner's later research work.

points.place: 英国格洛斯特郡伯克利
points.title: 乡村医生实践
points.description: 1773年，詹纳回到家乡伯克利，开始了他作为乡村医生的职业生涯。在接下来的23年里，詹纳不仅治疗各种疾病，还积极参与当地公共卫生事务。他观察到当地农民和挤奶工似乎对天花有免疫力，而这些人通常都曾患过牛痘。这一现象引起了詹纳的强烈兴趣，他开始系统地收集和记录相关病例。詹纳在繁忙的医务工作之余，坚持进行医学研究，特别是关于牛痘和天花的关系。他阅读了大量医学文献，与同行交流，并设计实验来验证自己的假设。这段时期是詹纳思想形成和积累的关键阶段，为他1796年的突破性发现奠定了坚实基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1773, Jenner returned to his hometown of Berkeley and began his career as a rural doctor. Over the next 23 years, Jenner not only treated various illnesses but also actively participated in local public health affairs. He observed that local farmers and milkmaids seemed to be immune to smallpox, and these people had typically contracted cowpox. This phenomenon sparked Jenner's strong interest, and he began systematically collecting and recording related cases. Despite his busy medical practice, Jenner persisted in medical research, particularly regarding the relationship between cowpox and smallpox. He read extensive medical literature, communicated with colleagues, and designed experiments to test his hypotheses. This period was crucial for the formation of Jenner's ideas and accumulation of knowledge, laying a solid foundation for his groundbreaking discovery in 1796.

points.place: 英国格洛斯特郡伯克利
points.title: 牛痘接种实验
points.description: 1796年5月14日，詹纳进行了历史上首次有记载的牛痘接种实验。他从挤奶工Sarah Nelmes手上取出的牛痘脓疱物质，接种到8岁男孩James Phipps的臂上。男孩随后出现轻微牛痘症状，但完全康复。1796年7月，詹纳故意让Phipps接触天花病毒，男孩没有感染天花。1798年，詹纳发表了《关于牛痘接种的原因和效果的探究》，详细描述了他的实验过程和结果。这一发现彻底改变了人类对抗天花的方式，开创了免疫学的新纪元。詹纳的接种方法简单、安全且有效，很快在欧洲得到推广，为最终消灭天花这一致命疾病奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: On May 14, 1796, Jenner conducted the first recorded cowpox vaccination experiment in history. He took material from a cowpox pustule on the hand of milkmaid Sarah Nelmes and inoculated it into the arm of 8-year-old James Phipps. The boy subsequently experienced mild cowpox symptoms but fully recovered. In July 1796, Jenner deliberately exposed Phipps to smallpox virus, and the boy did not contract the disease. In 1798, Jenner published 'An Inquiry into the Causes and Effects of the Variolae Vaccinae,' detailing his experimental process and results. This discovery revolutionized humanity's approach to combating smallpox, inaugurating a new era in immunology. Jenner's vaccination method was simple, safe, and effective, quickly gaining acceptance across Europe and laying the foundation for the eventual eradication of this deadly disease.

points.place: 英国格洛斯特郡伯克利
points.title: 晚年贡献与遗产
points.description: 1798年后，詹纳继续推广牛痘接种技术，并收到来自世界各地的医学界人士的咨询。他拒绝了多家医疗机构的职位邀请，选择留在伯克利继续行医和研究。1813年，牛津大学授予詹纳医学博士学位，但他婉拒了这一荣誉。詹纳晚年致力于完善疫苗接种技术，并研究其他疾病的预防方法。1823年1月26日，詹纳因中风在伯克利去世，享年73岁。詹纳的牛痘接种技术最终在全球范围内得到推广，为19世纪和20世纪的公共卫生革命奠定了基础。他的方法被应用于开发其他疫苗，开创了现代免疫学的先河。1979年，世界卫生组织宣布天花在全球范围内被消灭，这一成就很大程度上归功于詹纳的开创性工作。
points.descriptionEn: After 1798, Jenner continued to promote cowpox vaccination techniques and received inquiries from medical professionals worldwide. He declined offers of positions from various medical institutions, choosing to remain in Berkeley to continue his medical practice and research. In 1813, the University of Oxford awarded Jenner an honorary medical degree, which he politely declined. In his later years, Jenner dedicated himself to improving vaccination techniques and researching preventive methods for other diseases. On January 26, 1823, Jenner died of a stroke in Berkeley at the age of 73. Jenner's cowpox vaccination technique was eventually implemented globally, laying the foundation for the public health revolutions of the 19th and 20th centuries. His methods were applied to develop other vaccines, pioneering modern immunology. In 1979, the World Health Organization declared the global eradication of smallpox, an achievement largely attributable to Jenner's pioneering work.

appraisal.zh: 詹纳被尊为「免疫学之父」，其牛痘接种是人类医学史上最伟大的突破之一，开创了科学预防疾病的全新范式，他的名字几乎成为疫苗与预防医学的同义词。也有研究者指出，他的早期人体实验在伦理上存在争议，最初并未完全理解免疫机制的原理，且被认为忽视了Jesty、Plett等人的早期贡献，也未能更积极地推动接种普及。但这些争议并不动摇其地位：他标志着人类开始系统性地对抗传染病，是科学思维与公共卫生理念的胜利。
appraisal.en: Jenner is honored as the 'Father of Immunology'; his cowpox vaccination stands as one of the greatest breakthroughs in medical history, pioneering a new paradigm of scientifically preventing disease, and his name has become nearly synonymous with vaccine and preventive medicine. Some researchers note that his early human experiments raised ethical concerns, that he did not initially fully understand the principles of immunity, and that he was seen as neglecting earlier contributions by figures such as Jesty and Plett and as failing to promote vaccination more actively. These disputes do not unsettle his standing: he marks the beginning of humanity's systematic fight against infectious disease, a triumph of scientific thinking and public health.

supporter.zh: 爱德华·詹纳被誉为'免疫学之父'，他的牛痘接种技术是人类医学史上最伟大的突破之一。支持者认为詹纳不仅拯救了数亿人的生命，还开创了科学预防疾病的全新范式。他的工作体现了科学观察、实验验证和无私奉献的精神，为现代医学和公共卫生奠定了基础。詹纳的发现证明了科学方法的力量，展示了如何通过细致观察和实验解决重大健康问题，他的遗产至今仍在全球公共卫生领域发挥着重要作用。
supporter.en: Edward Jenner is hailed as the 'Father of Immunology,' and his cowpox vaccination technique stands as one of the greatest breakthroughs in medical history. Supporters believe Jenner not only saved hundreds of millions of lives but also pioneered an entirely new paradigm for scientifically preventing diseases. His work embodies the spirit of scientific observation, experimental verification, and selfless dedication, laying the foundation for modern medicine and public health. Jenner's discovery demonstrated the power of the scientific method and showed how meticulous observation and experimentation could solve major health problems, a legacy that continues to play a vital role in global public health today.

critic.zh: 批评者指出，詹纳的早期实验在伦理上存在争议，未经充分测试就在人体上进行实验。此外，詹纳最初未能完全理解免疫机制的科学原理，他的理论直到后来才被科学界完全接受。一些批评者认为詹纳过于强调自己的发现，而忽视了其他医生如Jesty和Plett的早期贡献。还有人批评詹纳未能充分利用他的发现带来的声誉和影响力，未能更积极地推动疫苗接种的普及，导致天花在英国的根除过程比预期更长。
critic.en: Critics point out that Jenner's early experiments raised ethical concerns, as he conducted human experiments without thorough preliminary testing. Additionally, Jenner did not fully understand the scientific principles of immunology initially, and his theories were not completely accepted by the scientific community until later. Some critics argue that Jenner overemphasized his own discovery while neglecting the earlier contributions of other doctors such as Jesty and Plett. Others criticize Jenner for not fully leveraging the reputation and influence that came with his discovery to more actively promote vaccination, resulting in a longer-than-expected process for eradicating smallpox in England.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，詹纳被定义为科学革命的象征人物，代表着从经验医学向现代科学医学的转变。他的故事常被用作科学方法论的典范，展示了观察、假设和实验验证的重要性。詹纳的名字已成为'疫苗'和'预防医学'的同义词，他的形象出现在各种医学纪念物和文化产品中。历史学家认为，詹纳的工作不仅是一项医学突破，更是科学思维和公共卫生理念的胜利，标志着人类开始系统性地对抗传染病。他的遗产超越了医学领域，成为科学进步和社会福祉的象征。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Jenner is defined as a symbolic figure of the scientific revolution, representing the transition from empirical medicine to modern scientific medicine. His story is often used as a paradigm of scientific methodology, demonstrating the importance of observation, hypothesis, and experimental verification. Jenner's name has become synonymous with 'vaccine' and 'preventive medicine,' and his image appears in various medical memorials and cultural products. Historians consider Jenner's work not merely a medical breakthrough but a triumph of scientific thinking and public health concepts, marking humanity's beginning to systematically combat infectious diseases. His legacy extends beyond medicine, becoming a symbol of scientific progress and social welfare.

self.zh: 我决心探索牛痘是否能保护人类免受天花侵害，这一想法源于我对自然的长期观察。
self.en: I am determined to investigate whether cowpox can protect humans from smallpox, an idea that stems from my long-term observations of nature.
